title: Product Milestone 10 — Commercial Subscriptions, Payments and Entitlements
objective: Plan provider-neutral subscriptions, verified payment events, server-side entitlements, usage limits, and learner-safe lifecycle handling without activating a payment provider.

tasks.title: Define versioned commercial plans
acceptance_criteria: Plan IDs, prices, billing periods, availability and superseding rules are provider-neutral and versioned.

tasks.title: Define server-side entitlements
acceptance_criteria: Learning access resolves from auditable entitlements rather than client or provider state.

tasks.title: Specify payment provider adapter
acceptance_criteria: Provider API, checkout and webhook boundaries expose no payment data to learning services.

tasks.title: Specify verified idempotent events
acceptance_criteria: Signature verification, replay defense, idempotency and ordering policies are defined before activation.

tasks.title: Model subscription lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Trial, active, grace, past-due, cancelled, expired and superseded transitions are explicit.

tasks.title: Plan recovery and reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Missed, duplicate and out-of-order events have deterministic reconciliation and audit behavior.

tasks.title: Define entitlement-aware usage limits
acceptance_criteria: Request, token and audio limits are enforced at trusted server boundaries with learner-safe responses.

tasks.title: Plan cost and access observability
acceptance_criteria: Metrics distinguish estimated AI cost, payment state and entitlement consumption without exposing credentials.

tasks.title: Plan terms, privacy and retention
acceptance_criteria: Versioned terms acceptance, minimization, retention and deletion responsibilities are reviewable.

tasks.title: Create commercial human decision gate
acceptance_criteria: No payment provider, deployment or public release can activate without explicit human approval.
